# McLoud Construction

> McLoud Construction is a locally owned general contractor serving the Kansas City metro
> (Missouri and Kansas), specializing in residential remodeling and commercial capital
> improvement projects. Quality work, honest communication.

## Services

- Residential remodeling: kitchen, bathroom, and whole-home remodels
- Commercial buildouts: retail, office, and multifamily amenity renovations
- Exterior work: paints, wood rot and trim replacement, stucco repairs
- Finish carpentry and clubhouse remodels for multifamily properties

## Service Area

Greater Kansas City metro, including communities on both the Missouri and Kansas sides.
